This directory vendors wedpr_l_bulletproofs 1.0.5 from crates.io.
Original archive checksum recorded in Cargo.lock: 30a40bf29b5f1ee2526389295af5f65b0b273823dc4814782a7d54bfa9c0221e
The original MIT LICENSE.txt and authors are retained.

Production changes are limited to the error dependency/derives and removal of
obsolete feature(nll). failure is replaced by thiserror and standard Error.
Standalone tests use the adjacent patched legacy dalek source.
Legacy fork test, benchmark and documentation imports are corrected to refer to
wedpr_l_bulletproofs. Such files were verified to differ only in this import.
README trailing whitespace is normalized; its text is unchanged.
No proof equations, randomness, transcripts, generators or encodings change.
The package version remains 1.0.5 to identify an explicit local backport.

The workspace root patch must be carried into downstream workspace roots.
Validation (stable Rust, no RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP):
  cargo +1.94.1 test --manifest-path third_party/bulletproofs-legacy/Cargo.toml --lib --test range_proof

Exact code/config diff against the original crate (zero context):
